how_to_apply: Go to the IC&SR careers page at https://icandsr.iitm.ac.in/careers/current_openings.php. Applications are accepted online only.
Register and look for advertisement number Advt.224/2026 on the page.

Submit the application for the relevant position by 4 November 2026. The system accepts only one application per registered login ID (email) for an advertisement. If you want to apply for more than one position, select all of them before you submit. A separate application has to be filled for each post.
Enter a correct, active email address. The Institute will send all correspondence by email only.
Submit the application. It cannot be edited or reverted after submission. Do not apply twice for the same post, as multiple applications from one candidate for the same post may be rejected.
Take a printout of the submitted application form. You will need it if called for the document verification, test or interview. Do not send a hard copy to the Institute.
A printout of the submitted online application form, to bring for the document verification, test or interview.
A No-Objection Certificate (NOC) at the document verification, test or interview, only for applicants already working on a project at IIT Madras who have not applied through proper channel.
A certificate of eligibility from the Government of India, needed before appointment only for migrants from Pakistan and subjects of Nepal.

Testimonials (optional) from people who know the candidate's work and character well. Candidates who are currently employed should submit testimonials from their most recent employer or immediate superior as a referee.

For technical problems with the application, email [email protected] or [email protected], or call 044- 2257 8843. These contacts are available on working days, Monday to Friday, from 9.00 AM to 05.30 PM, except National Holidays. Only technical issues are handled through these contacts. Questions about the selection process will not be answered in the meantime.

Meeting them does not by itself mean a candidate will be called for interview. The minimum qualification and/or experience can be relaxed for exceptionally outstanding candidates. The Institute may, at its discretion, relax the experience requirement for Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe candidates. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project Consultant gets Rs. 99,167/- per month (consolidated). The post is temporary and purely on a contract basis. It is initially for one year and can later be extended based on performance. Completing the contract does not give any right to further extension, regularisation or a permanent post at the Institute.

content_sections.heading: IIT Madras Project Consultant Job Description
content_sections.text: The Consultant is expected to: Work as the Research Manager for the project and be broadly responsible for leading day-to-day survey management with the survey firm, overseeing enumerator training, fieldwork quality control and daily progress tracking. Lead the day-to-day management of survey operations and serve as the key contact with the empanelled survey firm. This includes agreeing work plans, field deployment schedules and reporting formats, and holding the firm to the agreed protocols, timelines and deliverables. Coordinate any translation, back-translation and field-readiness of the survey instruments, including any reviews of the local language versions. Oversee the programming, skip logic and testing of the digital (CAPI) questionnaire before deployment. Organise and document any soft testing, pretesting and piloting, and make sure what is learned in these rounds feeds back into revising the instruments. Oversee any enumerator training that the survey firm conducts. Make sure the training covers study priorities such as matched youth–parent instruments, consent, and the skills needed to interview adolescents on sensitive subjects. Oversee fieldwork quality control and track progress against samples regularly. Implement and monitor the approved sampling protocol jointly with the Research Scientist II, including checking household eligibility and arranging any replacements needed for non-contact or non-response. Oversee the ethics, consent and safeguarding protocols during fieldwork, including consent and the confidentiality of respondent data. Ensure timely feedback between the field team and research leadership, including weekly field updates. Oversee data quality jointly with the Research Scientist II. This includes reviewing incoming survey data for completeness and consistency, spotting deviations from the approved sampling and survey protocols, and coordinating corrective action with the field team. Manage and supervise the Research Associate and the field-facing tasks given to the Research Intern, including allocating work, reviewing outputs and giving regular guidance on survey management and quality-control tasks.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted for a test and/or interview based on the information they give in the online application. The Institute decides how applicants are screened and tested for shortlisting and selection. It may limit the number of candidates called for a written test, skill test or interview to a reasonable number. This limit can be based on qualifications, a level and relevance of experience higher than the minimum, and other academic achievements. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted. Being called for a test or interview does not guarantee that the candidate will be recommended or selected. Admission to any stage is provisional, subject to confirmation that the candidate meets the eligibility conditions. A registration certificate or call letter does not mean the candidature has been found eligible. If any information or claim in the online application is found to be false, at any stage or at the test or interview, the candidature may be rejected. Applicants working on a project at IIT Madras who have no NOC will not be allowed to appear for the test or interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there for the IIT Madras Project Consultant post?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy for Project Consultant in the Department of Humanities and Social Sciences, IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Project Consultant post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IIT Madras Project Consultant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree in one of the social sciences and 10 years of experience managing research, teams, fieldwork and organizational arrangements. Only experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree is counted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IIT Madras Project Consultant?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 99,167/- per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the IIT Madras Project Consultant post?
faq.answer: Register and apply online at https://icandsr.iitm.ac.in/careers/current_openings.php, choosing advertisement number Advt.224/2026. Do not send a hard copy of the application to the Institute.

faq.question: Q6. How will the IIT Madras Project Consultant be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted for a test and/or interview based on the information in their online applications, and only shortlisted applicants will be contacted. The Institute decides how applicants are screened and tested.

faq.question: Q7. Is the IIT Madras Project Consultant a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is temporary and purely on a contract basis, initially for one year and later extendable based on performance. Completing the contract does not give any right to extension, regularisation or a permanent post.

faq.question: Q8. Which project will the IIT Madras Project Consultant work on?
faq.answer: The Consultant will work as Research Manager for the project "Social Media and Gen AI Safety in India: Youth and Parent Perspectives from Four States", funded by MeitY, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. Do current IIT Madras project staff need an NOC to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, unless they apply through proper channel. Applicants working on a project at IIT Madras must otherwise produce a No-Objection Certificate at the document verification, test or interview. Without it, they will not be allowed to appear.
